download_blink_dataset: download the BLINK multimodal reasoning benchmark dataset from HuggingFace and save images and prompts
download_blink_force: force re-download the BLINK dataset from HuggingFace even if data already exists locally
load_blink_prompts: load BLINK prompts from a local JSONL file into a dictionary keyed by lookup key
load_blink_prompts_filtered: load BLINK prompts filtered by a set of required lookup keys from the local prompts file
review_blink_configs: review the BLINK_CONFIGS list to see all 14 multimodal reasoning task categories available
